key_insight: The paper separates novelty-seeking exploration from policy optimization so RLVR can discover new reasoning strategies without harming the main model.
engineering_relevance: For math-reasoning LMs, ExpDis offers a practical training loop that scales exploration more safely than directly adding novelty bonuses to the optimized student.
method: Train explorer policies with a novelty bonus in the reward.
Filter explorer trajectories for correctness and quality.
Distill accepted trajectories into a separate student policy, then repeat in alternating rounds.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that ExpDis outperforms DAPO at the same wall-clock budget across seven math benchmarks and two model families, with improved pass@k scaling.
watch_item: The approach adds extra filtering and distillation stages, so its effectiveness may depend on the quality of correctness checks and trajectory selection.
paper_title: Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR
